messages:
mira: quick check-in  we need the canonical changelog + docs permalink for the blog post. whats our rollout window?
chris: aiming for 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC canary, 09:20 full. host infra ok with that.
jon: webinar scheduled for 10:00 UTC, landing page goes live at 09:15. need final docs link by 09:00 so slides and CTAs are accurate.
mira: noted. can you paste the short changelog we should use in the post? one para + bullet highlights.
chris: paste below - keep verbatim for the announcement header:
```
RWD-Infer v2.4.0 (2026-04-12)
- Adaptive batching overhaul: reduces tail latency under bursty traffic (-15% p95)
- New int8 quantization for A100 and H100 (saves 40% throughput cost)
- Improved stream checkpointing to avoid duplicate tokens
- Minor security and stability patches
```
mira: looks good. can we publish a one-line rollback thats consumer-friendly? we want transparency without scaring product folks.
jon: use: "If issues are detected, we roll back to rwd-infer-2.3.x within minutes and re-run smoke checks." ops will confirm exact SLA.
ops-oncall: ops will run smoke siphon at canary start and at +5m. Ill post status updates to #eng-oncall and tag the deploy channel.
dev-bot: Canary channel created: #deploy-1799000001-canary. Ill post deployment hooks and healthcheck outputs there.
mira: perfect. docs? sd-rep can we ensure registrant routing to SDR queue B with tag release-apr12?
sd-rep: yes, set webhook fields campaign=apr12-release, tag=release-apr12. we'll assign to SDR-B. sending mapping to #integrations in a sec.
chris: final artifact name is rwd-infer-2.4.0-release. ashley (docs) can you confirm permalink when live?
ashley: I'll publish the stable docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-2.4.0 by 08:55 UTC. preview is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-4-0
mira: marketing will draft the announcement copy using the changelog bullets and small benchmark note: "up to 15% p95 reduction on bursty workloads" - can eng confirm phrasing?
chris: change to "up to 15% reduction in p95 latency on our bursty traffic benchmark" - includes the qualifier.
mira: done. checklist follow-up: 
- chris: confirm deploy times (done)
- ashley: publish docs permalinks (pending, ETA 08:55)
- sd-rep: webhook mapping (in progress)
- ops-oncall: run smoke at canary (pending)
- mira: final announcement at T-10m and webinar CTA at T-5m
jon: Ill be on the pre-launch call at 08:30 UTC. good to go from infra side.
mira: great, schedule short preflight 08:30 and Ill post draft announcement for a final sign-off at 08:40. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
